0022600026.text: The Hornets (3-5, on a four-game losing streak) host the Boston Celtics (6-2, on a one-game winning streak) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup, Charlotte's 10th game of the season. Charlotte is 9th in the East and 3rd in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, while Boston is 3rd in the East and 2nd in the Atlantic, also 1.5 games back. Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (leg soreness) are out for Charlotte, and Devin Carter (illness) and Jayson Tatum (rest) are out for Boston, with Payton Pritchard listed as day-to-day with an eye abrasion and a game-time decision.
